summary: Vodafone filed a 6-K reporting the withdrawal of Resolution 7 (re-election of Hatem Dowidar as a director) from its 2026 AGM, following the board's announcement on 10 July 2026 of his immediate resignation. The event is the abrupt departure of a director, not a routine meeting notice. No terms, price, or deal-related details are present. The filing contains no advisor, recommendation, or structural mechanics. What to watch: whether further board changes follow or if the resignation signals strategic discord.
